usefulness.rationale: The dossier field is completely empty; the only content is a set of identity anchors (name, birth data, current role, family lineage) and one retained, unextracted source. No passage supports any substantive statement, so no overclaims can be identified from dossier text. A reader learns only that she chairs Santander since 2014 and is fourth-generation family leadership — nothing about her actions, decisions, or views. The dossier does not articulate its gaps (no 'what we do not know' section), so remainingQuestions scores 0. There is nothing usable to prepare for a meeting: no positions, priorities, recent statements, or verified history beyond bare anchors. The retained La Razón article (a 2026 Universia/AI quote piece) was never extracted, so even its content is unverified here. Note also the unjustified-conclusions list flags acquisition-authorship, rankings-as-authority, and inherited-role as unsupported inferences — but none of these appears as a dossier statement, so they are flagged as risks rather than matched overclaims.
